turns: 11; I added `e2e/api/generated/LIF-10.spec.ts` with one test tagged `@LIF-10`. It passes, and `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. No other file was changed.

The test creates two draft vendors, "Atlas Freight" and "Borealis Freight", each with a `uniqueName` suffix so parallel runs don't collide. It then sends `PATCH /api/vendors/{id}` to rename Borealis to the Atlas name in upper case. It asserts a 409 with `error.code` of `vendor_name_taken`, then re-reads Borealis and checks its name is unchanged.

I took the endpoint and body shape from `openapi.json`, which lists `PATCH /api/vendors/{vendor_id}` with a `name` field. The error code comes from the existing backend test for the same rule.
